x: At Philadelphia U.S.A. on February 5th Mal Robinson showed he is now back in form again by finishing 3rd to Olympic Silver medallist Maurice Herriott in an Indoor 2 mile race.
The heat overcame Maurice Herriott (24th) but Gerry, also uncomfortably hot, recovered well to finish 12th---1½ minutes down on winner Mamo Wolde of Ethiopia.
